# ssh admin@192.168.100.254:22 exit=0
FWF-80F-2R # show full-configuration
config system global
    set hostname "FWF-80F-2R"
    set admin-sport 55443
    set admintimeout 5
    set timezone "Asia/Shanghai"
    set dns-cache-limit 0
    set gui-theme mariner
end
config system interface
    edit "lan"
        set vlanid 0
        set ip 192.168.100.254 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https http snmp fabric speed-test
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 5
        set uuid 0d6bd8e0-1111-51f1-aaaa-bbbbccccdddd
        set color 32
        config secondaryip
            edit 1
                set ip 192.168.100.253 255.255.255.0
            next
        end
        set device-identification enable
    next
    edit "wifi1"
        set vlanid 0
        set ip 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 12
        set uuid 0d6bd8e0-2222-51f1-aaaa-bbbbccccdddd
    next
    edit "wan1"
        set allowaccess ping
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 9
        set uuid 0d6bd8e0-3333-51f1-aaaa-bbbbccccdddd
    next
end
config system admin
    edit "admin"
        set accprofile "super_admin"
        set trusthost1 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0
        set password ENC AK1jFAKEciphertextAAAA1111BBBB2222CCCC3333DDDD4444EEEE5555FFFF
    next
    edit "netops"
        set accprofile "prof_admin"
        set trusthost1 10.10.10.0 255.255.255.0
        set password ENC AK2jFAKEciphertextGGGG6666HHHH7777IIII8888JJJJ9999KKKK0000LLLLAAAA
    next
end
config system snmp community
    edit 1
        set name "public"
        set query-vdom disable
        set events cpu-high mem-low log-full
        set hosts
        end
    next
end
config system ntp
    set ntpsync enable
    set type fortiguard
    set server-mode disable
end
config system dns
    set primary 223.5.5.5
    set secondary 114.114.114.114
    set protocol cleartext
end
config router static
    edit 1
        set gateway 192.168.100.1
        set device "wan1"
        set distance 1
        set uuid 0d6bd8e0-4444-51f1-aaaa-bbbbccccdddd
    next
    edit 2
        set dst 10.20.0.0 255.255.0.0
        set gateway 192.168.100.2
        set device "wan1"
        set distance 1
        set uuid 0d6bd8e0-5555-51f1-aaaa-bbbbccccdddd
    next
end
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set name "lan-out"
        set uuid 0d6bd8e0-6666-51f1-aaaa-bbbbccccdddd
        set srcintf "lan"
        set dstintf "wan1"
        set action accept
        set utm-status disable
        set logtraffic utm
        set auto-asic-offload disable
    next
    edit 2
        set name "wifi-guest-deny"
        set uuid 0d6bd8e0-7777-51f1-aaaa-bbbbccccdddd
        set srcintf "wifi1"
        set dstintf "lan"
        set action deny
        set utm-status enable
        set logtraffic all
    next
end
config firewall address
    edit "obj-dns"
        set uuid 0d6bd8e0-8888-51f1-aaaa-bbbbccccdddd
        set subnet 8.8.8.8 255.255.255.255
        set allow-routing disable
    next
    edit "obj-any"
        set uuid 0d6bd8e0-9999-51f1-aaaa-bbbbccccdddd
        set subnet 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0
        set allow-routing enable
        set color 4
    next
end
config firewall vip
    edit "SSH-221-65222"
        set uuid 0d6bd8e0-aaaa-51f1-aaaa-bbbbccccdddd
        set extintf "any"
        set extport 221
        set mappedip "192.168.100.10"
        set mappedport 22
    next
end
config firewall ssl-ssh-profile
    edit "no-inspection"
        set comment "DEFAULT"
        set caname "Fortinet_CA_SSL"
        set inspection-mode flow
    next
end
config firewall internet-service-name
    edit "Google-Other"
        set internet-service-id 65646
        set type default
    next
    edit "Apple-Other"
        set internet-service-id 65647
        set type default
    next
end
config system sdwan
    set status enable
    config zone
        edit "LocalNet"
            set service-sla-tie-break cfg-order
        next
        edit "GlobalNet"
            set service-sla-tie-break cfg-order
        next
    end
    config members
        edit 1
            set interface "wan1"
            set zone "LocalNet"
        next
    end
end
config system replacemsg admin "admin-login"
    set buffer "<html><body>admin login page (default)</body></html>"
    set header http
    set format html
    set msg-type 2
end
config system replacemsg alertmail "alertmail-lib"
    set buffer "<html><body>fortigate alert mail</body></html>"
    set header http
    set format html
    set msg-type 2
end
config system replacemsg-group
    edit "default"
        set comment "predefined replacemsg group"
        config entries
            edit 1
                set msg-type 2
                set buffer "keep me"
            next
        end
    next
end

        set status disable

                set status disable
                set action block
            next
        end
    next
end

            next
        end

end
